decisions.guard_extension: precondition: fan_in embedding init with nontrivial embed_scale - init std must compensate the multiplier
decisions.note: Init-time weight-statistics spec conformance; std spec includes the embed_scale compensation.

decisions.guard_extension: topology: PP>1; phase: optimizer_step; precondition: VPP cuda-graph cast capture with shared mempool must not write other stages' param buffers
decisions.note: Another stage's cast-graph replay is a non-designated writer of this stage's parameter buffer.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: FP4 MoE recompute must use the quantization-aware checkpoint path so amax/scale state matches the original forward
decisions.note: Operator re-resolved to determinism from relation_statement: recompute-vs-original self-comparison within one step.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: MultiGroupDDP MoE per-bucket grad reduce (comm-dtype downcast, no zeroed partial buckets)
decisions.note: Reduced expert gradients are replicated state that must agree across the DP replication group.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: engine construction must not eagerly step() and pre-increment state['step'] before any real update
decisions.note: count_frequency_match coding is an equivalent restatement of T15's counter-increment-per-defined-event relation (O-023 precedent).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: fused CE z-loss - effective lse_square_scale must equal the configured z-loss multiplier
decisions.note: config_honoring aliases to config_effectiveness; configured knob silently nullified by hard-coded 0.0.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: mxfp8 reuse_grad_buf shared param/grad buffer must leave main_grad zero at first-accumulation start
decisions.note: Nonzero accumulation start state violates the zeroed-buffer clause of T07's conservation predicate.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: dataset index-cache fingerprint must cover all layout-determining settings (sequence_length, bos_token_id)
decisions.note: Operator re-resolved to config_effectiveness (O-NEW-56 precedent): served instance layout is the runtime-effective value of the configured sequence layout.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ZeRO-3 save must include requires_grad=False frozen parameters
decisions.note: Restore-equality violated for frozen params omitted at save; witnessed by checksum round trip.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ZeRO-2 contiguous_gradients=False extra-large-param reduction reference cleared per iteration
decisions.note: Operator re-resolved to conservation: stale previous-iteration gradient in the reduction is a foreign contribution violating sum-of-current-contributions.
Operator re-resolved to count_frequency_match ('counted once per step'); existing act-recompute precondition covers it; independent of M-NEW-21.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: MLA YaRN softmax scale computed from mscale_all_dim per the mscale formula
decisions.note: Operator re-resolved to reference_equivalence: computed scale vs YaRN closed-form spec value.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ZeRO-2 CPU-offload writeback partition_id computed within each group's own real_dp_process_group
decisions.note: Working-partition-equals-own-master-partition with destination slice per param group's process group; independent of D-NEW-29.

decisions.guard_extension: topology: DP>1; phase: init; precondition: bucket param_to_index must use globally padded per-param offsets
decisions.note: Operator re-resolved to sharding_layout_consistency: optimizer slice offsets must equal the padded layout mandated by the DP config.

decisions.guard_extension: phase: optimizer_step; precondition: zeroing grad_data in shared mxfp8 storage must not touch pending-all-gather param bytes
decisions.note: Grad-buffer zeroing is not a designated writer of other buckets' parameter data.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ZeRO-3 reduce-scatter buffer cast exactly when communication_data_type != model dtype (no inverted gate)
decisions.note: Collective operand must carry the configured communication dtype at launch.
Padding-metadata conservation across ranks shares no objects with T07/T12/D-027 (§3.2).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: HF-parity Qwen3 RMSNorm affine multiply in input dtype (cast before multiply)
decisions.note: Operator re-resolved to reference_equivalence: violation witnessed only against the HF reference implementation (§3.4), like the existing HF-parity RoPE-dtype precondition.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: MoE aux-loss metric under TP>1 free of tp_world_size factor and reduced over the designated group
decisions.note: Accumulated-metric scale factor mandated by spec; TP factor applied erroneously.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: DSA indexer aux loss divided by num_microbatches under gradient accumulation
decisions.note: Same 1/num_microbatches obligation as the MoE aux-loss precondition, independent incident.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: token embedding constructed with configured embedding_size (not vocab_size) when weight_tying=False
decisions.note: Operator re-resolved to config_effectiveness (O-NEW-56 precedent): constructed module size must equal the configured value.
Covered by existing ZeRO-1/2-CPU-offload and accumulation-steps>1 preconditions; not evidently the same incident as existing T07 supports.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: DTensor grad norm unwrapped before metric recording (no extra cross-rank reduction)
decisions.note: Reported grad-norm metric must equal reference recomputation; DTensor sharded clipping already a T09 concern.
Reset-to-initial over the trainer's global_step/LR state, not data-loader bookkeeping (T13 objects differ §3.2; T11 reset-vs-restore §3.3).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: extra-large-param reduction buffer allocated in configured communication dtype, not param.dtype
decisions.note: Independent of D-NEW-51 (different defect and fix on the same code path, §4.1).
